name: Bristol Winter Open 2024

venue.name: [Anson Rooms](https://www.bristolsu.org.uk/about-us/venues-and-shops/the-anson-rooms)
venue.address: Anson Rooms, Richmond Building, University of Bristol, 105 Queens Rd, Bristol, BS8 1LN

information:
Everyone is welcome to compete in this competition, and all competitors are eligible to win medals for podium positions. However, if you are a first-time competitor you may be more interested in the [Bristol Winter Beginners 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BristolWinterBeginners2024) competition. 

PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Bristol Winter Beginners 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BristolWinterBeginners2024). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BristolWinterOpen2024#43806-series-competition).

Please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free!**
